1920/3000/{}.compose:
name: vpn2
services:
  vmsingle:
    container_name: vmsingle
    image: vm:1
    mem_limit: 256m
    memswap_limit: 256m
    restart: always
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: 10m
        max-file: '3'
    network_mode: host
    labels:
      vpn2.spec: d7348717f671be5536fd7d31227afa9b9a94340ef7cc5684c9c23f24193aadfc
    security_opt:
    - apparmor=unconfined
    volumes:
    - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
    - /var/lib/vmsingle:/storage
    - /etc/anysda/vmsingle-scrape.yml:/etc/vm/scrape.yml:ro
    command:
    - -storageDataPath=/storage
    - -httpListenAddr=127.0.0.1:8428
    - -retentionPeriod=1d
    - -memory.allowedBytes=64MiB
    - -search.maxMemoryPerQuery=16MiB
    - -search.maxConcurrentRequests=4
    - -search.latencyOffset=1s
    - -promscrape.config=/etc/vm/scrape.yml
  anysda-vpn2:
    container_name: anysda-vpn2
    image: panel@sha256:2
    mem_limit: 384m
    memswap_limit: 384m
    restart: always
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: 10m
        max-file: '3'
    network_mode: host
    user: 996:995
    group_add:
    - '994'
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges
    volumes:
    - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
    - /etc/vpn2/tls/panel:/run/vpn2-tls:ro
    - /etc/anysda/anysda-config.yaml:/etc/anysda/config.yaml:ro
    - /run/vpn2-control:/run/vpn2-control:ro
    - /var/lib/anysda-vpn2:/var/lib/anysda-vpn2
    environment:
      NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=256
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: '51821'
      HOST: 127.0.0.1
      NUXT_SESSION_PASSWORD: s$$1
      NUXT_DATABASE_URL: file:/var/lib/anysda-vpn2/db.sqlite
      NUXT_ANYSDA_CONFIG_PATH: /etc/anysda/config.yaml
      NUXT_WG_ENABLED: 'true'
      NUXT_WG_LISTEN_PORT: '51820'
      NUXT_WG_SERVER_IP: 10.66.66.1
      NUXT_WG_SUBNET_PREFIX: 10.66.66.
      NUXT_WG_PUBLIC_HOST: 203.0.113.10
      NUXT_WG_ENDPOINT_IP: 203.0.113.10
      NUXT_NODE_HOSTS: ru=203.0.113.10,se=198.51.100.2,de-1=de.example.org
      NUXT_PREVIOUS_NODE_HOSTS: ru=1.2.3.4
      NUXT_WG_MTU: '1380'
      NUXT_WG_SPLIT_LOCAL: 'true'
      NUXT_OVPN_ENABLED: 'true'
      NUXT_OVPN_PORT: '1194'
      NUXT_OVPN_PROTO: tcp
      NUXT_OVPN_PUBLIC_HOST: 203.0.113.10
      NUXT_CLASH_SECRET: c
      NUXT_CLASH_API_URL: http://10.99.0.1:9090
      NUXT_AGH_URL: http://127.0.0.1:3000
      NUXT_AGH_USER: anysda
      NUXT_AGH_PASSWORD: p
      NUXT_EXIT_TAGS: se de-1
      NUXT_MGMT_MESH_IP_PREFIX: 10.99.0.
      NUXT_MGMT_IPS: ru:10.99.0.1,se:10.99.0.2,de-1:10.99.0.3
      NUXT_VM_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8428
      NUXT_TGBOT_SECRET: t
      NUXT_TGBOT_EVENT_PORT: '8877'
      NUXT_PUBLIC_SSO_ENABLED: 'false'
      NUXT_PUBLIC_SSO_AUTO_REDIRECT: 'false'
      NUXT_PUBLIC_SSO_LABEL: Authentik
      NUXT_SSO_ALLOWED_SUBS: a,b
      NUXT_SSO_PASSWORD_LOGIN: 'true'
      NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_CLIENT_ID: vpn2
      NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET: ''
      NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_OPENID_CONFIG: ''
      NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_REDIRECT_URL: ''
      LOG_LEVEL: info
    command:
    - sh
    - -ec
    - export NUXT_SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=$$(cat /run/vpn2-tls/secure); exec node .output/server/index.mjs
  anysda-tgbot:
    container_name: anysda-tgbot
    image: bot@sha256:1
    mem_limit: 128m
    memswap_limit: 128m
    restart: always
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: 10m
        max-file: '3'
    network_mode: host
    user: 999:998
    group_add:
    - '997'
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges
    volumes:
    - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
    - /var/lib/anysda-vpn2/runtime/telegram-runtime.json:/etc/anysda/telegram-runtime.json:ro
    - /var/lib/anysda-tgbot:/var/lib/anysda-tgbot
    environment:
      TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: 1:a$$b
      TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID: '42'
      TELEGRAM_ADMIN_USERNAME: ''
      TGBOT_SECRET: x
      TGBOT_EVENT_PORT: '8877'
      TGBOT_POLL_STALL_SEC: '300'
      ANYSDA_URL: http://127.0.0.1:51821
      TG_PROXY: http://127.0.0.1:7897
      ALERT_CPU_PCT: '90'
1920/3000/{}.scrape:
global:
  scrape_interval: 2s
  scrape_timeout: 1s

scrape_configs:
  - job_name: node-ru
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['127.0.0.1:9100']
        labels: { host: ru, instance: '10.99.0.1:9100' }
  - job_name: node-se
    proxy_url: 'socks5://127.0.0.1:10102'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['127.0.0.1:9100']
        labels: { host: se, instance: '10.99.0.2:9100' }
  - job_name: node-de-1
    proxy_url: 'socks5://127.0.0.1:10103'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['127.0.0.1:9100']
        labels: { host: de-1, instance: '10.99.0.3:9100' }
